instructions: Registration & Login FAQ only. Use for short Q&A; use the paired Word document for detailed how-tos and edge cases. Follow the common rule book for shared assistant behaviour across all modules.

faqs.question: How do I create a TEFConnect account?
faqs.answer: Join Now or Create an account → choose Profile Type → fill required fields → accept Consent Clause for Data Collection and Privacy Policy → Register → Verify Your Email.

faqs.question: How do I log in?
faqs.answer: Sign In/Login → select User Type → Email Address → Password → Login. Use the same account type you registered with.

faqs.question: What account types can I register as?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneur, Mentor, Investor, Marketplace. Alumni, Partner, and Community Admin are not Register options.

faqs.question: What account types can I log in as?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneur, Mentor, Investor, Previously funded entrepreneur, Marketplace. Previously funded signs into Alumni Community path.

faqs.question: What are the password rules?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneur/Marketplace: ≥8 chars, uppercase, number, symbol. Mentor/Investor/Previously funded login: non-empty password on the form. Legacy set-password uses full complexity.

faqs.question: How do I reset a forgotten password?
faqs.answer: Forgot Password? on Login for Entrepreneur, Mentor, Investor → email → Send. Not shown for Marketplace or Previously funded. Legacy alumni may use First time? Request access email.

faqs.question: I did not get a verification email.
faqs.answer: Check spam/junk. Use Resend Verification Email on login when shown. Support on login includes enquiries@tonyelumelufoundation.org.

faqs.question: What happens after I register?
faqs.answer: Verify Your Email → Got it → verify via inbox link → log in.

faqs.question: Where do I go after login?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneur complete → Home; incomplete → My Profile. Mentor approved → Dashboard; incomplete/not approved → Mentorship profile. Investor/previously funded → Alumni Community (or profile edit). Marketplace → Marketplace home/edit/status by gate.

faqs.question: My Marketplace account is deactivated.
faqs.answer: Login as Marketplace → Reactivate account when shown → continue by access status.

faqs.question: Why can’t I use Dashboard as a mentor yet?
faqs.answer: Not approved yet → Mentorship profile. You may also need Change password on first login.

faqs.question: Previously funded entrepreneur access.
faqs.answer: Login → Previously funded entrepreneur → First time? Request access email if needed → Set your password from email → Go to login → sign in.

faqs.question: Name and email rules on Register?
faqs.answer: Email 5–100 chars. First/Last name required 2–50 letters/spaces. Middle optional same if filled. Gender Male/Female where required.

faqs.question: How do I log out?
faqs.answer: Logout → confirm Are you sure you want to log out? Typically returns to Home. Marketplace logout also ends Marketplace session.

faqs.question: What are SSO sign-in pages?
faqs.answer: Token hand-offs: Signing you in… / Opening Mentorship… / Marketplace sign-in. No email/password on those pages.

faqs.question: This email is already registered.
faqs.answer: Use Login with correct User Type, or Forgot Password if available. Do not register again for the same type.

faqs.question: Can I register as Alumni or Community Admin?
faqs.answer: No from Register Profile Type list. Previously funded is a Login path. Community Admin arrives via SSO when provisioned.

faqs.question: How do I get help with login?
faqs.answer: Resend Verification Email, Forgot Password, or Reactivate when shown. Login shows enquiries@tonyelumelufoundation.org.

faqs.question: What is the Home login modal?
faqs.answer: Login / Registration with New User? and Already a User? then Continue to Register or Login.

faqs.question: Wrong User Type selected.
faqs.answer: Login fails for that type. Choose the type you registered with; there is no automatic cross-type detection.

faqs.question: Mentor forced Change password rules.
faqs.answer: Uppercase required; confirm must match. Stay on Login until completed.

faqs.question: Register with Marketplace preselected.
faqs.answer: Marketplace CTA/profileType can lock Profile Type or User Type to Marketplace.

faqs.question: Investor register fields.
faqs.answer: Investor mainly registers with names, email, password (language/country/gender/region hidden).

faqs.question: Mentor register extra fields.
faqs.answer: Mentor also requires Sector (and typical language/country/region/gender fields).

faqs.question: Email Verification Required on login.
faqs.answer: Use Resend Verification Email for entrepreneur/marketplace/investor verification paths as shown.

faqs.question: Set your password page.
faqs.answer: Create a password to access the TEFConnect Alumni community → Set password → Go to login. Requires email token.

faqs.question: Is phone required on Register?
faqs.answer: No. Phone is not collected on Register/Login forms.

faqs.question: Google/Microsoft sign-in on Home?
faqs.answer: Hero Google/Microsoft buttons are not live in the current product.

faqs.question: Already logged in opened Login/Register.
faqs.answer: You are redirected based on profile completion status.

faqs.question: Marketplace after login destinations.
faqs.answer: Allowed → Marketplace; REQUIRES_PROFILE → profile edit; pending/changes/rejected → status page.

faqs.question: Mentor incomplete profile after login.
faqs.answer: Goes to Mentorship profile until complete/approved.

faqs.question: Entrepreneur incomplete after login.
faqs.answer: Goes to My Profile.

faqs.question: Forgot Password not showing for Marketplace.
faqs.answer: Correct — Forgot Password link is not shown for Marketplace or Previously funded on the login form.

faqs.question: SSO missing token error.
faqs.answer: You see an error with Go to login / Back to alumni profile / Back to login depending on the hand-off.

faqs.question: Partner register option?
faqs.answer: Partner is not a selectable Register Profile Type on the form.

faqs.question: Consent checkbox.
faqs.answer: Required: By clicking create account, you agree to our Consent Clause for Data Collection and Privacy Policy.

faqs.question: Create an account subtitle.
faqs.answer: Start your journey to limitless opportunities today.

faqs.question: Login welcome text.
faqs.answer: Welcome — Please login to your account.

faqs.question: Password symbols allowed.
faqs.answer: At least one symbol from the allowed symbol set is required for Entrepreneur/Marketplace complexity rules.

faqs.question: First time? Request access email.
faqs.answer: Shown for Previously funded entrepreneur login to request the access/set-password email.

faqs.question: Mentors opening Marketplace.
faqs.answer: Mentors are redirected away from Marketplace browsing except SSO hand-off paths.

faqs.question: Redirect query after login.
faqs.answer: Honored when profile is complete and the destination is allowed for that account/gate.

faqs.question: Registering... / Logging in...
faqs.answer: Loading labels while the request runs.

faqs.question: Region required?
faqs.answer: Required when shown for Entrepreneur/Mentor/Marketplace register flows.

faqs.question: Preferred Language required?
faqs.answer: Required when shown (not for investor register fields).

faqs.question: FAQ for Registration modal.
faqs.answer: May open first on Register; dismiss with Ok.

faqs.question: Sign Up on legacy signin page.
faqs.answer: Primary Register/Login pages are the supported auth flows for end users.

faqs.question: Official support contact on login.
faqs.answer: enquiries@tonyelumelufoundation.org
